h1: Scheduled store backups you can restore
overview: Backups are only useful if they work on the day something goes wrong. We set up automatic backups for your products, customers, orders, theme and pages, choose a safe place to keep them, and test a restore so you know it works. You get a one page recovery guide that says what is backed up, how often and what to do first in a crisis. The backup tool and storage stay in your own accounts.

faq: Does my platform not back up automatically?
Hosted platforms keep their own records, but they do not restore a deleted product or a broken theme on request. A backup of your own gives you a way back that you control.
In your own cloud storage or the backup tool's storage under your account. We do not keep a copy ourselves, so your customer data stays in your hands.
No. They run in the background, usually at quiet hours, and most tools only copy what changed.
Can you restore the store if it breaks later?
The recovery guide shows how. If you need us to restore it, we handle that as a separate order, and the tested setup makes it faster.
